title: Reduced-Rank Autoregressive Models for Matrix Time Series
summary: Matrix time series is a series of matrix data observed over time. Analytical tools for such time series is needed in many applications in finance, economics, engineering and many other fields. To avoid the use of vectorization of the matrices which loses the column and row information, and the vector autoregression framework in traditional time series analysis, \cite{chen2021autoregressive} proposed the Matrix Autoregressive (MAR) Model.
